translations.warning_title: WARNING — COLLISION AND PRINTER DAMAGE RISK
translations.warning_body: Non-planar toolpaths can cause print head collisions, damage your printer and ruin the part. Use at your own risk. Check clearances and supervise the entire print. Never leave the printer unattended.
translations.warning_preview: Preview only. Printing still requires verification of the transitions and the print head.
translations.warning_bead: Preview only. Some beads are below the profile’s minimum layer height. Printing requires validation of deposition and print head clearance.
